{{Otheruses|Gauntlet}}
{{Quote|So I declare you and your pilots exiles. Remove yourself from Cartann, by gauntlet to Giltella Air Base, and never show yourselves before me again.|Perator Pekaelic ke Teldan to Wedge Antilles|<ref name="SoA">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>}}
The '''Gauntlet''' was a form of execution in the nation of [[Cartann]].<ref name="SoA" />

Whoever the reigning [[perator]] declared an exile and ordered to go through the gauntlet could be [[Death/Legends|killed]] legally by anyone without any repercussions. The only way to escape was to reach the place designated by the perator by any means necessary.<ref name="SoA" />

During [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] unit [[Red Flight]]'s diplomatic mission to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]], they were ordered by the acting [[Pekaelic ke Teldan|perator]] to go through the [[Gauntlet of Red Flight|gauntlet]] due to [[General/Legends|General]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles's]] refusal to lead the forces of Cartann against the other nations.<ref name="SoA" />
